sources.era5_scaled: Open-Meteo era5 scaled by the calendar-month ratio to the observed series
sources.feed_control: ecmwf_ec46 control run (days ERA5 had not published)

members.note: member-major arrays over horizon.date as the models are driven with them; the control run is one of the members; n_negative_prec raw rain values below zero (feed noise) are kept here and set to 0 in the cumulative sum

cumulative_prec_mm.note: running sum of each member's rain (negative raw values set to 0) from the issue date; climatology: the same calendar window in every complete observed year
